title: YSR Congress Names Princeton Entrepreneur Siva Meka as Its USA Convenor
excerpt: The Princeton-based entrepreneur, founder of ESOA Technologies and associated with Yatra and Save the Tigers, will coordinate the party's outreach among US supporters.
body:
• The YSR Congress Party has appointed entrepreneur and community activist Siva Meka as its USA Convenor, giving him charge of the party's outreach among supporters in the United States.
  • Meka is based in Princeton, New Jersey, and hails from Munnangi village in Guntur district, Andhra Pradesh.
  • He is the founder and senior executive of ESOA Technologies, and has been associated with the production of Yatra, Yatra 2, and the OTT series Save the Tigers.
  • The appointment formalizes the party's diaspora leadership at a time when Telugu NRIs play an outsized role in Andhra Pradesh's political fundraising and campaign narratives.

The appointment

Entrepreneur and community activist Siva Meka has been appointed USA Convenor of the YSR Congress Party, the Andhra Pradesh opposition party led by Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy. The role puts Meka in charge of coordinating the party's activities and outreach among its supporters across the United States — a diaspora community that has become central to how Andhra parties fundraise, campaign, and shape narratives back home.

Meka is based in Princeton, New Jersey, and hails from Munnangi village in Kollipara mandal of Guntur district. He holds a B.Tech from JNTU College of Engineering and an MBA from the Asia Pacific International School in New Zealand, and his professional background spans technology, media, and real estate.

"Meka is based in Princeton, New Jersey, and hails from Munnangi village in Kollipara mandal of Guntur district."

The profile

Meka is the founder and senior executive of ESOA Technologies, Inc., where he has worked in software services, global business development, and client management. He has a foot in the entertainment industry as well: he has been associated with the production of Yatra and Yatra 2 — the biographical films on Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy — and the popular OTT series Save the Tigers. He has also been involved in digital media initiatives and collaborations involving artificial intelligence in content production.

In real estate, his profile states he was part of the master planning and execution team for Sundara Homes, a 160-acre mixed-use development in Lytle, Texas, planned with around 600 residential units alongside retail and commercial infrastructure.

Community work

His community record includes drinking water purification projects in rural areas, health camps, scholarships, and financial assistance for underprivileged students in India and the United States. He has maintained close links with the Telugu diaspora and has been associated with the YSR Foundation (USA), the party's diaspora philanthropic arm.

Why it matters

Telugu NRIs in the US — concentrated in New Jersey, Texas, and California — are among the most politically organized diaspora groups in Indian politics. YSRCP has long maintained a formal USA committee structure, and naming a single convenor with both business standing and party-loyalist credentials signals that the party is consolidating its American operation ahead of the next electoral cycle. For Telugu Americans, the appointment is also a marker of which figures the party trusts to represent it in the diaspora's community spaces, from temple events to fundraising dinners.

What to watch

How Meka uses the convenor platform: whether the US operation becomes primarily a fundraising engine, a social-media amplifier for the party's Andhra narratives, or a genuine community-organization effort among Telugu NRIs. The YSRCP's previous US social media committee, announced ahead of the 2024 elections, showed how seriously the party takes the digital reach of its American supporters.
